evidence.description: The supplied Stata file describes the main-analysis preparation workflow.
evidence.quote: * The code below details the steps used to obtain and manipulate the raw data used for the main analyses in the paper.

evidence.description: Manual Capital IQ screens, years, reshape, merge, and requested fields.
evidence.quote:
* 1. Manual Download from S&P

*For each variable below, use a new screen and input the screening criteria Geography In United Kingdom. Select fiscal years 2010 through 2020. Include the additional fields in each screen: EntityID EntityName yearstring Geography CompanyName Ticker CompanyStatus  IndustryClassification Sector IndustryGroup Industry PrimaryIndustry SICCode CompanyType CountryRegionName.
*Once the output is created, download each screen, open in excel, import to stata, and reshape the data to panel format using the command " reshape long var, i(EntityID) j(year, string) "
*merge files by EntityID and year
*variables: IQ_INT_EXP IQ_Debt FTE IQ_Total_Rev IQ_COGS IQ_GEO_SEG_REV_ABS IQ_TOTAL_ASSETS IQ_AR IQ_STDEBT IQ_EBITDA IQ_COMMON_DIV_DECLARED

evidence.description: The program reads a RepRisk identifier file, filters UK headquarters, and saves a filtered identifier file.
evidence.quote:
use "...\q5874d8b8ee069c40.dta" 
tab HEADQUARTER_COUNTRY
keep if HEADQUARTER_COUNTRY=="GB"
save "...\reprisk identifiers UK only.dta"

evidence.description: The program reads a second RepRisk file and uses dated risk observations.
evidence.quote:
use "...\qb72a60cba72fa61f.dta" 
merge m:1 REPRISK_ID using "...\reprisk identifiers UK only.dta"
gen year=year(date)
drop if missing(ISIN)
replace CURRENT_RRI=CURRENT_RRI/100
bysort ISIN year: egen annualRRI=mean(CURRENT_RRI)
duplicates drop ISIN year, force

evidence.description: A separate prepared annual AP/AR panel is read for later analysis.
evidence.quote:
use "...\Combined Annual AP and AR.dta", clear
drop _merge
merge m:1 IQ_INDUSTRY_GROUP using "...\reprisk1.dta"

evidence.description: The earlier in-memory preparation block saves the derived panel, which later table sections load.
evidence.quote:
save "...\GMP dataset_f.dta"

* 3. Main Analyses

* Table 2
use "...\GMP dataset_f.dta", clear

evidence.description: The Table 3 section reads the prepared PPDR file.

*save "...\PPDR data.dta"

evidence.description: The Table 4 section documents the survey workbook and reads the combined response file.

review_notes: The assessment target is the complete supplied Code_GMP.do main-analysis workflow. The frozen title and DOI are preserved exactly. The appendix title says Dynamics while the main code and datasheet say Contracting; this is contextual version/output comparison only, with no mandatory attribution issue or prerequisite.

The workflow trace records the manual Capital IQ panel, each supplied construction stage, the line 176 unique ISIN/year file, all six frozen dependency IDs, and the supplied Table 2, Table 3, Table 4 Panels A/B, Table 5, and Table 6 consumers. Appendix-only analyses without supplied executable stages remain contextual.
The datasheet describes Identifiers.dta as an identifier list. Its bounded probe returns EntityID only, and Code_GMP.do does not read it; it is not treated as an analysis panel.

The three credential/connection scan versions are retained as process artifacts only. The final scan emitted only appendix line 138 and its hash; matching text remains withheld and no source/evidence record or access conclusion uses that line. The broader earlier scan overmatched generic author wording and was corrected without altering source bytes.

Catalog helper construction failures and the RepRisk V2 metrics timeout are preserved in their original probe records; only successful bounded catalog and data-metadata results are cited as scientific evidence. Catalog misses and one-row probes do not establish entitlement, absence, or historical coverage.

The official static GOV.UK check confirms public availability of reports through a government service, but not a bulk export contract, field schema, or exact report-period completeness. No data payload, author program, model, regression, or statistical trial was run; no software was installed and no source or data was edited.

Preflight 001 detected the schema-required closure_complete field and trailing blank-line quote-boundary mismatches in two cached PDF text citations. The exact failed draft, helper, command, and streams are preserved; the scope flag and citation windows were corrected from the registered cached text before finalization.

A coordinator locator clarification states that the sweep run_root resolves audit/artifact locators only. It is not an execution or data root; any later authorized run uses a separate isolated working directory outside the controller run and frozen generation. The clarification is preserved at probes/root_locator_correction_002/locator_clarification_process_record.json as process guidance, not author-source evidence.

The prior root wording was corrected before acceptance. The prior finalized assessment/proposal pair, draft, and workflow trace are preserved in probes/root_locator_correction_002; the immutable coordinator checkpoint retains the wider probe history.
